_comment: Fixture variables for standalone rendering of search_bar.dart.jinja2 AND search_bar.html.jinja2 (serves both output legs). widget_class_name is the generated class name; file_stem is the lower-snake-case filename stem used to derive the cubit/state import paths; hint_text is the search input placeholder. The html-only key result_groups drives the grouped results panel; items may omit subtitle (the template guards with 'subtitle' in item) — values transcribed from the v1.0 oracle render.
